common_execution_contract: pending target position kept separately from filled position
filled quantity and position updated only from FillRecord
cumulative ExecutionReport synchronization using a fill cursor
decision bars-since-entry used to preserve legacy signal cadence during latency
signal-to-intent and PnL remain in the existing execution/backend/result layers
reference_deviation_long_specific: RDV indicator history and BUY/SELL/HOLD predicates
BUY maps to target long and SELL maps to target flat

excluded: fee, funding, slippage, PnL, or result generation

migration_boundary: Strategy-specific adapters supply signal mapping and call unchanged signal functions. LegacyExecutionState observes signals as pending targets and observes fills as actual positions.
